app.name: Moldy Market Admin
app.tagline: Administration portal for the escrow secondhand marketplace.

dashboard.title: Admin workspace
dashboard.subtitle: Pick a module below or use the sidebar navigation to get started.

feedback.forbiddenMessage: Your account does not have permission to view or perform this action.

errors.default: Could not complete the request. Please try again later.
errors.FE_NETWORK_ERROR: Unable to reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.FE_UNKNOWN_ERROR: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.
errors.COMMON_003: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.COMMON_004: You do not have permission to perform this action.
errors.DISPUTE_005: This dispute is no longer open for review.
errors.WALLET_006: Withdrawal state does not allow this action.
errors.INVALID_REQUEST: Invalid request payload. Please review your inputs.

disputes.title: Disputes & refunds
disputes.subtitle: Review buyer evidence and adjudicate escrow refunds or order completion.
disputes.searchPlaceholder: Search by order code, product title...
disputes.emptyDescription: There are no dispute requests matching the active filter.

decision.APPROVE_DESC: Refund the full escrow amount back to the buyer wallet.
decision.REJECT_DESC: Dismiss the dispute and complete the order for the seller.

detail.title: Dispute details
detail.notePlaceholder: Explain the evidence basis for approving or rejecting this dispute...
detail.confirmApproveText: This credits the escrow refund to the buyer wallet and closes the dispute. This cannot be undone.
detail.confirmRejectText: This dismisses the dispute and completes the order for the seller. This cannot be undone.
detail.approvedSuccess: Dispute approved and refund credited to the buyer wallet.
detail.rejectedSuccess: Dispute rejected and order marked completed.

withdrawals.title: Withdrawal approvals
withdrawals.subtitle: Approve, confirm completed bank payouts, or reject user wallet withdrawal requests.
withdrawals.searchPlaceholder: Search by ID, bank, account holder...
withdrawals.emptyDescription: No withdrawal requests match the current filter.

dialog.reasonPlaceholder: Explain why this withdrawal is rejected or failed...

approve.title: Approve withdrawal #{{id}}?
approve.description: Move withdrawal of {{amount}} to {{holder}} ({{bank}}) into Processing.

complete.title: Mark withdrawal #{{id}} completed?
complete.description: Confirm {{amount}} was transferred to {{holder}} ({{bank}}). Pending hold will be settled.

reject.title: Reject withdrawal #{{id}}?
reject.description: Reject withdrawal of {{amount}} for {{holder}} ({{bank}}) and return funds to available balance.

fail.title: Mark withdrawal #{{id}} as failed?
fail.description: Record payout failure of {{amount}} for {{holder}} ({{bank}}) and return funds to available balance.

success.reject: Withdrawal #{{id}} rejected and funds returned to wallet.
success.fail: Withdrawal #{{id}} marked failed and funds returned to wallet.

vouchers.title: Platform vouchers
vouchers.subtitle: Inspect all marketplace vouchers and issue new platform-wide discount codes.
vouchers.emptyDescription: No vouchers match the active filter.

form.title: Issue platform voucher
form.subtitle: The server automatically assigns the PLATFORM issuer scope.

validation.discountValuePositive: Discount value must be greater than 0.
validation.quantityPositive: Usage quantity must be a positive integer.
validation.expiredAtFuture: Expiry date must be in the future.
validation.minOrderNonNegative: Minimum order value cannot be negative.
validation.maxDiscountPositive: Maximum discount must be greater than 0.

users.title: User management
users.subtitle: Search, view and lock / unlock violating accounts.
users.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, email or phone
users.emptyDescription: Try a different keyword or filter.

lock.title: Lock account
lock.description: Lock {{name}} ({{email}}). They will be signed out and cannot sign in until unlocked.
lock.detailPlaceholder: e.g. Posted 30 duplicate listings within 1 hour
lock.ownsStore: This user owns the store "{{store}}". The store will not be blocked automatically.
lock.openOrders: This user has {{count}} orders in progress. They will continue.

unlock.title: Unlock account
unlock.description: Unlock {{name}} ({{email}}). They will be able to sign in again.

validation.detailRequired: Please describe the violation (at least 5 characters).
validation.noteTooLong: Note must be at most 500 characters.

detail.openOrdersWarning: Orders in progress: {{buyer}} as buyer, {{seller}} as seller.
